label: Wildlife Fieldcraft
description: Field rigs and disciplines of working wildlife photographers — how the frame was physically made, from long glass to camera traps.

items.name: 600mm-bag-hide
items.text: shot on a 600mm f/4 super-telephoto resting on a beanbag in a ground-level hide, eye-level with the animal, the background compressed into a wash of habitat color
items.text_short: 600mm f/4 from a ground hide, eye-level

items.name: teleconverter-blind
items.text: an 840mm teleconverter rig braced on a vehicle-blind window mount, heat shimmer trembling in the far distance, focus locked hard on the nearest eye

items.name: floating-hide
items.text: shot from a floating hide with the lens barely above the water, subject and its reflection meeting in one low mirror-line sightline

items.name: camera-trap
items.text: a wide-angle DSLR camera trap fired by an infrared beam, soft off-camera flashes rigged days in advance, the animal photographing itself mid-stride at close range

items.name: remote-ground-rig
items.text: a remote wide-angle camera placed at ground level hours ahead and triggered from a distance, paws huge and horizon low in the exaggerated close perspective

items.name: gimbal-pan
items.text: a fluid gimbal head panning with the running animal at 1/30 second, legs and habitat streaked into motion while the eye stays pinned sharp

items.name: belly-crawl-stalk
items.text: a long stalk finished flat on the ground, elbows in the dew, shooting wide open through out-of-focus grass stems that frame the subject in soft green

items.name: canopy-platform
items.text: shot from a canopy platform at branch height, level with the treetop world instead of craning up at it, leaves layering soft around the clear sightline

items.name: boat-drift
items.text: shot from a drifting boat with the engine cut, the long lens braced on the gunwale, a low skimming angle across open water
items.text_short: long lens braced on a drifting boat

items.name: headland-scope
items.text: shot from a clifftop headland on a fluid head, the long lens angled slightly down over open water, swell lines stacking soft in the compressed distance
items.text_short: clifftop long lens over open water

items.name: ghillie-wrap
items.text: a ghillie-suited photographer melted into the undergrowth, lens hood wrapped in scrim, shooting through a natural gap in the foliage
